subject: NBA full-game Winner contract, Odds API mapping and FVS applicability

body.content: Hello Novig team, Please route this to the team responsible for the exact NBA product and governing settlement rules. I'm reviewing whether the NBA h2h prices distributed through The Odds API's novig source can be used in The Corner's analytical model. Your sports help page lists NBA Winner markets. The contract index retained on October 1 listed WNBA but did not supply an NBA Winner contract. Your Fair Value Settlement guidance describes valuation rather than return of entry cost; we need to establish whether it governs the actual feed product. A request on October 2, 2026 at 11:12:08 UTC returned 44 NBA events but no Novig prices. We therefore cannot yet provide a concrete Novig source or contract ID, and do not claim this proves product unavailability or applicability of any rules. We are separately asking The Odds API for the source mapping. 1. Please provide the complete NBA full-game Winner contract, contract ID/revision, effective period, governing rulebook/member agreement and precedence rules. 2. Can you identify or verify the product represented by The Odds API's novig NBA h2h quotes using their source IDs? If not, please say so explicitly. 3. Does FVS govern this exact NBA contract? List each trigger and any exceptions, including tied interruption, abandonment, delayed start, postponement, cancellation, forfeit and inability to verify an official outcome. 4. For each non-decisive branch, is original stake/entry cost returned, or is a valuation paid? Specify reference time, calculation window, price sources, fees, payout for both sides, and whether net profit/loss can be non-zero. 5. Confirm overtime inclusion, decisive outcome structure, tie/push treatment, completion windows/timezones, market-title overrides and correction/finality. 6. Identify product transitions, their effective dates and which prior terms continue to govern previously opened contracts. Which source authenticates revisions and notifies users of changes? Please identify the responding team and cite the controlling retained documents. An inability to confirm the mapping is useful evidence, not something we will replace with an inferred match. No trading or account credentials are requested. If the exact feed mapping must be provided by The Odds API first, please identify what evidence you need. Please also state any restrictions on retaining your clarification and cited rules for internal audit. No credentials are requested. Thank you, Edward Cooper
